answer: Attackers forging many identities must post real capital for each, so a thousand fake participants cost a thousand bonds, and slashing burns them on proof of collusion. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bond that decays per epoch unless it performs verified work. Honest agents recover stake through peer-attested tasks, like traders crossing a canyon who must pay a toll at the oasis, an economics fable where cheap talk fails but collateral speaks. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
